criteria.requirement: Extend fenced_code with closing_fence="exact" default and opt-in "at_least". At-least mode accepts a standalone closing fence of the same character at least as long as the opening run, keeps shorter runs inside code, rejects mixed-character/nonstandalone closers and supports backticks/tildes, language/attrs/highlight metadata and normal escaping. Scope regex/configuration per processor instance so one conversion cannot change later default output. Unknown mode rejects. Preserve all legacy exact-mode fixtures, including the intentional historical behavior, and avoid converting container/indentation semantics not included in this delivery.
